problem.description: Console warnings about pages being created with unknown prop 'params' in SvelteKit application

root_cause.description: SvelteKit 2 automatically passes 'params' prop to page components, but components don't declare this prop

technical_details.detail: SvelteKit routing system injects props automatically
Components without 'export let params' declaration trigger warnings
This is a known SvelteKit behavior that requires warning suppression

previous_fix.description: SvelteKit Params Warning Fix was implemented
previous_fix.details: Enhanced warning suppression in svelte.config.js for 15 SvelteKit internal props

solution.approach: Update svelte.config.js to properly suppress 'params' prop warnings

steps.step: Enhance onwarn handler to suppress params warnings
